jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer III
jobs_results.description:
🌟 Join Our Thriving DevOps Team and Make Your Mark on the Future of Communication Technology! 🚀

Are you ready to embark on an exhilarating journey at the forefront of innovation? Look no further! Our DevOps team is seeking passionate engineers like you to revolutionise the infrastructure behind the Vonage Business Communication platform.

As a key player in our dynamic team, you'll dive deep into the heart of cutting-edge technology, supporting multiple geographically distributed teams and driving the evolution of our homegrown PaaS solution based on Kubernetes running on AWS. From crafting robust CLI tools in Node.js and TypeScript to orchestrating infrastructure with Terraform, your expertise will be instrumental in shaping the future of our platform.

What You'll Do:
• Lead end-to-end efforts in CLI development, infrastructure modules, hosting infrastructure, and application-level services, ensuring seamless operation for our diverse teams.
• Champion best practices and... standards while spearheading improvements and upgrades to our Kubernetes clusters.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate tools and services for security, compliance, high availability, and more.
• Provide extensive support to teams utilizing the platform, fostering collaboration across offices and time zones.

About the Team:

Join a close-knit team comprising a DevOps lead and talented engineers across offices in the US, India, and Israel. Together, we're committed to pushing the boundaries of what's possible and fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.

Tech Stack:
• Dive into a rich tech stack featuring Kubernetes, ArgoCD, AWS, Terraform, ELK stack, Grafana, OpsGenie, Node.js, Python, and Java.

Requirements:
• 3-5 years of hands-on experience as a DevOps engineer with a strong focus on Kubernetes.
• Proficiency in advanced Kubernetes patterns, including blue/green updates and stateful workloads, to drive continuous improvement of our cloud architecture.
• Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and upgrading Kubernetes clusters in a production environment.
• Expertise in deploying applications to Kubernetes using tools like Helm, Kustomize, or equivalent.
• Solid grasp of Docker and container technologies, coupled with experience in managing production-level services on AWS.
• Willingness to take on-call responsibilities to ensure the reliability and stability of our platform.

Nice to Have:
• AWS certification to showcase your expertise in cloud technologies.
• Prior experience building internal platform engineering tools with Python or Go.
• Familiarity with GitOps practices, including FluxCD and ArgoCD.

Ready to elevate your career and shape the future of communication technology? Join us and become part of a team that's pushing boundaries, breaking barriers, and making an impact worldwide. Apply now and let's build something extraordinary together! 🚀✨

#LI-JB1

#LI-REMOTE

jobs_results.title: Devops Engineer (Platform engineering & networks)
jobs_results.description:
About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

About the role:

The Cloud Center of Excellence is responsible for developing Gartner’s capabilities in automating and streamlining IT infrastructure processes and DevOps tasks while improving Gartner’s self service capabilities using public cloud platforms and open-source technologies.

In this role, you will be responsible for helping to define and implement strategies for foundational services such as Identity and Access Management (including role-based access control, AWS IAM Policies, Single Sign On and Federated Access) and Networking (Transit Gateway, Direct Connect and... Firewalls). The candidate will also focus on designing, implementing and maintaining the underlying cloud infrastructure as well as developing and deploying cloud native solutions ensuring optimal performance, scalability and security. Along with a systemic discipline we are also looking for candidates who can approach the DevOps discipline in new and creative ways and who are open and passionate about exploring new technologies to improve our overall environment. We give infrastructure and support to all the business units of Gartner, with a strong focus on performance. This is a great opportunity for an individual looking to make an impact from day 1, working both in Cloud Engineering and Security, in all cloud platforms.

What you’ll do:
• Help establish patterns and build automation to manage cloud Identity and Access Management - IAM services.
• Build automation for configuration and operationalization of cloud networking services.
• Ensure that appropriate procedures and architectures are documented.
• Drive cloud native and designed for failure architectures across the enterprise
• Comfortable working with distributed teams and evangelizing the benefits of cloud and automation.
• Strong expertise in leveraging a wide variety of open source technologies
• Automation is in your DNA – not satisfied with performing repeatable work. Automate wherever you can, and ensure enterprise grade scale and security is built into your automation
• Self-Service – develop self-service capabilities so consumers can use the service without requiring manual action
• Collaborate with a cross-functional team of application developers, engineers, designers, and product stakeholders to deliver innovative technology solutions.
• Maintain performance, security, and availability of production systems to achieve 99.99% uptime.
• Build pipelines, Maintaining Cloud infrastructure services, monitor our networks and participate in high-scope projects for Gartner IT.
• Create and manage highly resilient environments.
• Automate deployments (CI/CD) & other repetitive tasks using shell/PowerShell/Python scripts or tools like Jenkins.
• Configure and leverage configuration management using tools like SSM or Puppet.
• Configure automated alerts/monitors and act on any outages/incidents.
• Ensure that the infrastructure is secured.
• Develop, document and/or refine processes to standardize and automate wherever possible.
• Collaborate with internal teams to understand systems, integrate with them, and develop SOPs for supporting them.

What you’ll need:
• Knowledgeable with identity and access management technologies
• Experience with structuring Role-Based Access Control policies, AWS IAM Policies
• Experience working with complex network topologies and hardware
• Experience with monitoring solutions such as Dynatrace, DataDog
• Experience with Logging technologies such as Splunk
• Linux, Unix, and Windows operating systems
• Proficient in coding/scripting skills in Python, Terraform
• Experience working in a multi-cloud environment – AWS/Azure/GCP
• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt Stack
• Collaborate with colleagues to support and improve architecture, systems, processes, standards and tools.
• Write and maintain clear, concise documentation, runbooks and operational standards including infrastructure diagrams
• Ensure all solutions are properly monitored and instrumented
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in development, test and production environments
• Write and maintain code for automating the creation of scalable/resilient systems/infrastructure
• Review existing and proposed architectures with an eye towards cost optimization
• Continuously identify, adopt, & refine best practices
• Self-motivated, eager to learn and ready to share knowledge with other team members.
• Degree in computer science or related focus, or equivalent experience
• 3+ years of experience in Software and/or Infrastructure, with a desired 2+ years in a relevant cloud, automation, and orchestration.
• Fundamental knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM), Networking configuration (preferably cloud) and cloud platform services.
• Ability to translate business and security requirements into proper IAM policies.
• Build and liaise with key business stakeholders throughout the project to ensure a timely implementation and roll-out.
• Monitors industry trends and directions; develops and presents substantive technical recommendations to senior management.
• Proficient in analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral and written communication skills with strong ability to influence both IT and business partners
• Ability to prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment

What you’ll get:
• Competitive Compensation Packages
• 23 days annual holiday, and additional days off for your birthday, 24th & 31st of December.
• Private Medical and Dental Care.
• Life and Disability Insurance.
• Public Transport Subsidy.
• Ticket Restaurant Card.
• Childcare Vouchers (Ticket Guarderia).
• IncentiFit - annual reimbursement for health-and-wellness-related activities.
• Spanish lessons.
• Pension Scheme.
• Tuition Reimbursement.
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
• Employee Assistance Program.
• Gartner Gives Charity Match.
• Relocation Assistance - a specialist to help you with all the appointments and paperwork.

PLEASE NOTE:

- Applications must be submitted in English.

- A valid EU visa/passport is required for this position.

#LI-AL2

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT), we deliver actionable, objective insight that drives smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization’s mission-critical priorities. We’ve grown exponentially since our founding in 1979 and we're proud to have over 19,500 associates globally that support over 15,000 client enterprises in more than 100 countries.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our teams are composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. We believe that a diversity of experiences makes us stronger—as individuals, as communities and as an organization. That’s why we're recognized worldwide as a great place to work year after year. We've been recognized by Fortune as one of the World’s Most Admired Companies, named a Best Place to Work for LGBTQ Equality by the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index and a Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion by the Disability Equality Index. Looking for a place to turn your big ideas into reality? Join #LifeAtGartner

What we offer:

Our people are our most valuable asset, so we invest in them from Day 1. When you join our team, you’ll have access to a vast array of benefits to help you live your life well. These resources are designed to support your physical, financial and emotional well-being. We encourage continued personal and professional growth through ongoing learning and development opportunities. Our employee resource groups, charity match and volunteer programs keep you connected to your internal Gartner community and causes that matter to you.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling Human Resources at +1 (203) 964-0096 or by sending an email to ApplicantAccommodations@gartner.com .
Job Requisition ID:85564

By submitting your information and application, you confirm that you have read and agree to the country or regional recruitment notice linked below applicable to your place of residence.

jobs_results.title: Backend & DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
This awesome gig is for someone who's ready to take on a dual role in backend development and DevOps. We're looking for a dynamic, versatile professional who's excited to tackle both.
Team Structure: You'll join our tight-knit team of 10 dedicated engineers, where you'll be collaborating with the squad to come up with innovative solutions for the energy industry.
• You'll develop, implement, and maintain scalable, high-performance backend systems using TypeScript and a microservices architecture.
• You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement new features and enhancements. Of course, you'll always be striving to improve code quality through writing unit tests, automation, and conducting code reviews.
• As our Backend & DevOps Engineer, you'll also implement and manage continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using GitOps principles and Kustomize. When infrastructure issues arise, you'll proactively monitor, diagnose, and troubleshoot them to... ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
• You'll work closely with the development team to optimize the deployment process and streamline development workflows using Kubernetes. We're always on the lookout for new technologies to improve efficiency and performance, so you'll also be researching and implementing these as needed.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 3+ years of experience in backend development, preferably with TypeScript and microservicesStrong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL
• Proficiency in containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
• Experience with Kustomize, GitOps, and cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or AzureKnowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a collaborative team environment
• High English level (C1)
• Experience working with corporate clients
• Experience with self-hosted deployment of B2B software
• We offer a competitive salary and bonus structure. You'll enjoy an extremely steep learning curve in a fast-paced, high-tech B2B company with an international team that has a 'global citizen' mindset. We promote a culture of freedom and responsibility, where innovation is encouraged and nurtured.
Other benefits include:
• 23 official pay vacation days + bank holidays and days when the company does not operate
• Hybrid and flexible working environment
• Free coffee, tea, snacks, and fresh organic fruit
• Sports and wellness package, including monthly massages/ Ticket Restaurant
• Company-sponsored team fun events every quarter and other cool after-work activities

In FlexiDAO we embrace diversity by having and promoting an inclusive and diverse environment. Therefore, we are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, or gender identity or expression.

While we have listed certain requirements for this position, ​we encourage all qualified candidates to apply, even if you don't meet every single requirement listed in the job description. If you're passionate about our mission and believe you have the skills and potential to contribute to our team, we want to hear from you.
• Phone/Google Meet interview with a Talent Recruiter
• Google Meet with our Backend team lead developer & CTO
• Google Meet for a technical Test

We don’t offer just a “job”. It’s about building cool stuff that matters, together with a great team.
If you see yourself working with us and can meet the key requirements, send your CV to join FlexiDAO to careers@flexidao.com

Enrich the state capital of Munich as

DevOps Engineer with focus on Operations(f / m / d)

Whether Bavarian, English orJavaScript. We understand each other.

Full-time and part-time possible

Permanent

Application deadline : 01.05.2024

E 11 TVöD / A 11

Start : as soon aspossible

Possibility to work from home

Procedure number : 11510

Your area of application

Owncompany IT@M, Customer Management, Customer Center 1 - KVR and FireDepartment, Agnes-Pockels-Bogen 21-33, 80992 Munich

The state capital of Munich

The ITdepartment is responsible for and shapes the entire IT of the Cityof Munich. We ensure that IT provision meets the city's current andfuture needs.

We drive the digitalization of the city of Munich andplay a pioneering role. Our work and our services... make the city ofMunich a digital metropolis that sets standards that its employeesare proud of.

As part of the IT department, we ensure amodern IT and telecommunications infrastructure, implementprofessional IT solutions and secure the IT operations of the Cityof Munich with over 1,200 employees in our own company it@M.

What you can expect

Asa DevOps Engineer, you will find yourself in an exciting workenvironment that includes optimizing existing applications as wellas implementing and planning (new) IT solutions.

As part of DevOps,you will also be responsible for operating Linux servers, whichalso includes analyzing and eliminating faults (service requests,2nd / 3rd level support, etc.).

Your tasks will includethe operation and maintenance of IT systems for the specialistprocedures supported in the service area (including trade,restaurants, weapons, regulatory offenses, lost property managementand fire inspection).

This includes monitoring and troubleshooting,ensuring the required availability, carrying out operationalsecurity measures (e.

g. installing releases from internal andexternal process manufacturers, restarting applications) and systemoptimizations.

In all these activities, you will alwayswork together with your team colleagues and in close coordinationwith our customers in the district administration department andthe fire department, the external product manufacturers, theinternal and external partner procedures and our infrastructureteams.

Occasionally, the job requires you towork outside of core working hours. This can occasionally lead toweekend work or on-call duty.

What we offeryou
• Independent, autonomousprocessing of your own area of responsibility
• a permanent position in EGr. 11 (depending on experiencelevel from € 4,032.38 to € 5,975.19 gross per month for full-timeemployment)
• Annual special payment as wellas an attractive company pension scheme, capital-forming benefits,a local and family allowance, coverage of the Deutschlandticket Jobor subsidy for the IsarCardJob (tax-free) and performance-relatedpay
• Possibility to rent a company apartmentfrom LHM

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (mid or senior role)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

We help the world see new possibilities and inspire change for better tomorrows. Our analytic solutions bridge content, data, and analytics to help business, people, and society become stronger, more resilient, and sustainable.

Job Description

DevOps is the practice of operations and development engineers participating together in the entire service lifecycle, from design through the development process to production support. DevOps is also characterized by operations staff making use many of the same techniques as developers for their systems work.

This role’s main purpose is to increase a product team’s ability to deliver applications and services at high velocity, via a combination of automation, tools, process changes, practices, etc.

Following the foundations of the DevOps I and II, the DevOps Engineer III is the main point of contact within a product team for all the DevOps activities. This role is a key part of the Software Development/Testing... Lifecycle, being an active part of technical reviews and maintaining the roadmap in that product team, being an example for another DevOps and contributing to extend the DevOps Culture at Sequel.

Main responsibilities:
• Leads strategic improvements within a Development Team autonomously.
• Design and implement of Build and Release improvements to the Development Team.
• Work closely with products and architecture team to design and support new architectures (containers, microservices, serverless).
• Design and implement new automation tools.
• Define and deliver DevOps strategic improvements.
• Assist with providing third-level support to business users.
• Work on new and existing applications along with enhancements to websites, web applications, and infrastructure.
• Write design technical documents.
• Participate actively on reviews and technical design meetings and provide valuable feedback.
• Mentor other DevOps Engineers (levels I, II).
• Run training sessions for Development Teams so the knowledge on the CI/CD tools and processes are understood.
• Suggests new tools and participates in the evaluation of those.
• Takes responsibility for the delivery of the changes coordinating people in the team.
• Responsible of the follow-up of the implementation of the strategic improvements and best practices in each DevOps team.
• Write design technical documents. Makes sure all the key processes are documented.
• Share information in DevOps forums.
• Completes all special projects and other duties as assigned.
• Any other duties commensurate to the grade of the role.

#LI-SD2 #LI-Hybrid

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree preferred in Computer Science or other relevant field and extensive related experience.
• Working knowledge of all phases of the software development life cycle.
• Good knowledge of object-oriented programming concepts, testing pyramid and design patterns.
• Good knowledge of functional programming concepts.
• Good knowledge of SQL Server administration.
• Good knowledge of infrastructure/application level monitoring services.
• Good knowledge of Container architectures, good practices and know-how, including container orchestrator services like Kubernetes and Swarm.
• Deep understanding of Version Control System (migrate between VCS, troubleshoot issues with VCS, analysing performance issues).
• Deep understanding of Build and Package process (understanding dependency issues, managing Framework updates, analysing performance issues, optimize packaging process).
• Deep understanding of Release process (zero-downtime deployments, after-release testing, analysing performance issues, application monitoring).
• Good understanding of infrastructure concepts (performance analysis, post-mortem analysis).
• Ability to do a risk analysis.
• Ability to provide estimates and provide cost-based design.
• Ability to review other team members work.
• Demonstrated ability to implement new automation tools.
• Demonstrated ability to improve CI/CD process.
• Demonstrated ability to write technical documents including database design, application design and ongoing documentation of changes and modifications.
• Demonstrated ability to spread knowledge across the team.
• Set measurable goals and meets them.
• Good communication skills. Ability to lead stand-ups, retrospective and technical review meetings.

Additional Information

For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster.

At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and second consecutive year in Poland. We value learning, caring and results and make inclusivity and diversity a top priority. In addition to our Great Place to Work® Certification, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer and Best Employer for Women, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations.

Verisk Businesses

Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision

Claims Solutions — supports end-to-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences

Property Estimating Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day-to-day workflows the most efficient

Extreme Event Solutions — provides risk modeling solutions to help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to extreme events.

Specialty Business Solutions — provides an integrated suite of software for full end-to-end management of insurance and reinsurance business, helping companies manage their businesses through efficiency, flexibility, and data governance

Marketing Solutions — delivers data and insights to improve the reach, timing, relevance, and compliance of every consumer engagement

Life Insurance Solutions – offers end-to-end, data insight-driven core capabilities for carriers, distribution, and direct customers across the entire policy lifecycle of life and annuities for both individual and group.

Verisk Maplecroft — provides intelligence on sustainability, resilience, and ESG, helping people, business, and societies become stronger

Verisk Analytics is an equal opportunity employer.

All members of the Verisk Analytics family of companies are equal opportunity employers. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, veteran's status, age or disability.

http://www.verisk.com/careers.html

Unsolicited resumes sent to Verisk, including unsolicited resumes sent to a Verisk business mailing address, fax machine or email address, or directly to Verisk employees, will be considered Verisk property. Verisk will NOT pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
TUI Group is the world’s number one integrated tourism business. We never stop looking ahead, seeking new ways to delight our customers and grow our business. We recognise the power of digital and the massive contribution this brings to creating a truly unique and differentiated customer experience.

Mobile is a global team within TUI technology responsible for TUI’s Mobile apps and Global Payment solutions. We are a multi-disciplinary team of experts across Architecture, Engineering, DevOps and Agile Delivery providing services across the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark,Finland, Germany, Austria, Belgium, The Netherlands and Aviation, Cruises and destinations worldwide.

This a great opportunity to join a team of innovative and passionate people, who are driving the development, operation, and ongoing evolution of mobile apps powering one of Europe’s largest travel and experience provider with over €6.5bn revenue per year.

We are looking for a talented and dedicated DevOps... engineer to join the Platform Team in the Mobile Tech organisation which looks after TUI’s Mobile applications (iOS and Android).

The Platform Team is a mix of DevOps and SRE members who work in a very collaborative and supportive environment, where knowledge is shared and where we push for quality instead of quantity, were we always think forward about Automation, Security and Reliability of our systems.

As new joiner of the Platform Team you will be mentored and we will work together to bring you up to speed and to improve our AWS infrastructure, Automation, CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins and Gitlab, Bitrise CI/CD (for mobile), improve our Monitoring System and alerting
and automate our infrastructure deployment with Terraform and Terragrunt.

ABOUT THE JOB
• As a Devops Engineer, you will be part of a cross-functional team that is a mix of SRE/DevOps engineers. Being an enthusiast as DevOps, with a strong Security mindset, and thanks to your excellent collaboration skills you will work with your team to deliver the best answers to our customers’ needs and to take over full responsibility for its applications, from design to operation.
• Care diligently about the quality of your work, including proper documentation and security aspects.
• You will use your deep technical skills to enable your team to deliver operation excellence, ensure and improve reliability, performance, maintainability of systems and services.
• Work closely with your team to understand the operational processes, technical and business needs of the products and services your team is responsible for.
• Ensure observability of systems and services, support change and configuration management.
• Be involved in raising operational readiness requirements as part of the development life cycle and validate software development and delivery is consistent, meeting the specified requirements.
• Hunting for performance optimisations and recognize upcoming problems before our customers are impacted.
• Continuously improve CI/CD and automation maturity and efficiency.
• Support your team with efficient incident handling and quick reaction to production problems. For this you can expect to take part in on-call rota. You can work hands-on, being able to tackle the whole design, build, test, deploy cycle and thus also take proactive corrective action where required.
• Verbalise your thoughts and ideas and take the initiative to translate ideas into outcomes. Together with the teams in the Domains, relevant Practice teams as well as the Group Enabler teams you also will research, evaluate and test new approaches, processes and tools and help teams to use them effectively.
• Demonstrate active contribution to Communities of Practice, including collaboration in shared initiatives.
• You love to work in an international, multi-cultural team.
• Challenge constructively and have high expectations of yourself and others.
• Always drive for technical excellence, ownership and self-organisation at team and personal level.
• Eager to learn and acquire new skills and keep up to date with latest developments in your focus areas.
